extraction.name: WebWalkerQA
extraction.description: A benchmark designed to assess the ability of LLMs to perform web traversal. It evaluates the capacity of LLMs to traverse a website’s subpages to extract high-quality data systematically.
extraction.creator: Jialong Wu, Wenbiao Yin, Yong Jiang, Zhenglin Wang, Zekun Xi, Runnan Fang, Linhai Zhang, Yulan He, Deyu Zhou, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: We first collect root official websites across conference, organization, education, and game domains. Then we mimic human behavior by systematically clicking and collecting subpages accessible through sublinks on the root page. Using predefined rules, we leverage GPT4o to generate synthetic QA-pairs based on the gathered information, followed by manual verification to ensure accuracy and relevance.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Software Collection, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Root official websites across conference, organization, education, and game domains identified through Google search.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Traverse official websites recursively, collecting information on accessible sub-links and their respective pages. Verify and filter for legitimate queries that deviate from natural, human-like phrasing, retaining only QA pairs with short answers containing entities.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Two-stage funnel annotation strategy combining LLM-based and human annotation. In the first stage, GPT-4o performs initial annotations. In the second stage, crowd-sourced human annotators conduct quality control and filtering, rewriting and calibrating the questions and answers to ensure correctness and consistency.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Dataset Size: Currently comprises 680 high-quality QA pairs. Multimodal Environment: Only utilizes HTML-DOM to parse clickable buttons, not visual modalities like screenshots. Agent Tuning: WebWalker is driven by prompting without additional training.
